shapeFraming.stringEncoding: uint32 byte length followed by strict UTF-8 bytes
shapeFraming.ordering: ascending ordinal UTF-8 bytes of logicalName
shapeFraming.record: uint32 payloadByteLength, then payload: uint32 zeroBasedOrdinal, LP_UTF8(logicalName), LP_UTF8(bundleRelativePath), uint32 profileCount, LP_UTF8(each profile in Base,Yuri enum order), LP_UTF8(purpose)
shapeFraming.digest: lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the complete framed byte stream

sourcePathRules.bundlePrefix: AUTHORS, VERSION, or global mix database.dat
